verdict.rationale: Fellow documents automatic meeting summaries, action items and decisions, but nothing in the evidence shows it drafting a follow-up email for the user to review and send. The API note about passing transcripts to an LLM for recaps is a developer building block, and the MCP connector to outside AI assistants is an adjacent feature; neither counts as the product drafting the email itself.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
